documents.text: The water came up through the floor around 2am on the 12th. By morning it was about knee height in the living room. We got out through the back door.
The sofa and the rug are a total loss. Everything that was on the floor is soaked. The fridge tipped over at some point during the night.
We have not been back inside since Thursday because the fire department said the outlets were underwater and it was not safe.

HOME DEPOT #4412
2023-04-11
Rheem 40gal water heater   $1,250.00
Install kit                  $48.99
TOTAL                     $1,298.99
Thank you for your purchase.
ServPro invoice 22-8831. Emergency water extraction, 3 rooms, $2,400.00. Payment due on receipt. Questions: billing@servpro-local.example.com
Estimate for flood restoration. Remove and replace lower cabinets east and north runs, $3,100. Replace buckled plank flooring in living room, $2,850. Baseboard trim throughout, $640. Subtotal $6,590.

Scope: mold remediation in closet and kitchen. Containment, HEPA air scrubbing, antimicrobial treatment. Approximately 0.55 sq m affected. Estimated range $900 to $2,600 depending on substrate condition.

Structural note: diagonal crack observed in hallway partition, roughly 1.8 m. We recommend a licensed structural engineer assess before we quote repair. We cannot approve a scope without that assessment.
Walked the property in VR. Waterline consistent at about 0.9 m on all walls. Ceiling stain in kitchen sits well above that line and looks like a separate cause, flagging for wind-vs-water review.
Furnace and water heater both fully submerged. Do not energize. Recommend gas utility disconnect before any contractor enters the closet.
Homeowner states prior damage from a 2019 storm was repaired and paid out. Need to confirm with claims history before finalising the contents portion.
I am asking for the maximum the policy allows because we lost almost everything on the ground floor. I understand the adjuster has to approve it.
Invoice: debris haul-away, three piles, $285.00 total. Scheduled pickup 2026-11-09.
Label on water heater: Rheem Performance 40 Gal. Model XE40M06ST45U1. Serial 0423X88291. Max temp 150F.
Handwritten note on fridge: Mom - took the dog to Aunt Carol's. Power is off. Call me when you get this. - J
Electrical panel label: MAIN 200A. Circuit 14 - kitchen outlets. Circuit 15 - living room. Circuit 16 - water heater.
